verdict.rationale: Linear documents team-based visibility controls: private teams and sub-teams can be restricted to parent-team members or hidden from everyone except invited members, and initiatives led by private teams are visible only to their members. An admin role exists for managing access centrally and approving apps. However, the evidence shows no documented granular role system or per-item edit-versus-view permissions, so control is mostly visibility at the team level. Missing for 10: documented custom or granular roles, edit-level permission controls distinct from visibility, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work

citations.quote: Private to team members — the team is hidden, except to members directly invited to that sub-team
